decisive_items: Echocardiography revealed pulmonary atresia with ventricular septal defect and a patent ductus arteriosus
Anti-platelet antibodies and platelet-associated immunoglobulins were negative
Platelet aggregation time was 127 s (reference, 61–110 s)
response.rationale: The congenital heart defect is definitively diagnosed by echocardiography and explains the clinical course; the thrombocytopenia lacks immune markers and is likely secondary to cyanotic heart disease, making the provisional ITP diagnosis unsupported.

rejected.why: Only a provisional diagnosis; negative antiplatelet antibodies and abnormal aggregation time argue against immune thrombocytopenia, and platelet count did not respond to IVIG.
